title: ERC20: transfer amount exceeds allowance
summary: The spender's allowance from the owner is less than the amount being transferFromed.
likelyCauses: Missing approve() call.
Approval to wrong spender.
USDT-style: must reset to 0 before raising approval.
nextSteps: Call approve(spender, amount) (or use Permit2 / EIP-2612 permit).
For USDT, approve(0) then approve(amount).

title: ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance
summary: A transfer was attempted for more tokens than the sender holds.
likelyCauses: UI quoted a stale balance.
Decimals mismatch (1.0 token vs 1.0 * 10^18 units).
Token has a hidden fee that lowers available balance.
nextSteps: Refetch balanceOf right before sending.
Confirm decimals.
